policies.title: Welcome to Chutzpah Catering
policies.text: In a world of frozen foods, artificial ingredients, and mass produced meals, we have taken the old fashioned approach.  Everything is prepared using only the freshest ingredients, choicest poultry, meats and cheeses.  We believe in overstuffed sandwiches, generous portions and overflowing plates.  This catering menu is designed to reflect that, while offering a wide variety of tastes and presentations.  If you cannot find exactly what you desire, please do not hesitate to call us.  We will make every effort to assure your complete satisfaction.

policies.title: Ordering
policies.text: Deadline for placing orders is 3 PM the day prior to delivery. We do understand that last minute orders do occur, and we will do our best to complete the order whenever possible.  Certain menu items require 48 hours notice. Please keep in mind that we request a minimum of 10 guests per selection.

policies.title: Cancellations
policies.text: Please contact us by 3 PM the day prior to the scheduled delivery to avoid a cancellation fee of 25%.

policies.title: Payment
policies.text: We accept cash, personal checks, corporate checks, most major credit cards, and corporate accounts.
